description: OpenAI client call through Novita, one chat turn, traced by OpenInference through cetra's SDK.
notes: The client keeps the real base URL https://api.novita.ai/openai, and the harness routes the request to the capture mock under that host (D-IN-3). cetra's SDK stamps the OpenAI client's host on the span as server.address api.novita.ai (D-IN-18), so the provider is novita from the endpoint rule (D-IN-2). The model deepseek/deepseek-v3.2 is priced by the snapshot's Novita row, a vendor/model row kept by the converter (D-IN-14). Cost is computed, not reported. Token counts are input 14 and output 8.
